<template>
    <v-btn color="primary" @click="openAddPriceDialog">
      <v-icon left>mdi-plus</v-icon>
      Add Price Entry
    </v-btn>
  </template>
  
  <script>
  import { ref } from 'vue'
  import { useStore } from 'vuex'

  export default {
    name: 'AddPriceEntryButton',
    setup() {
      const store = useStore()

      const openAddPriceDialog = () => {
        store.commit('setAddPriceDialogOpen', true)
      }

      return { openAddPriceDialog }
    }
  }
  </script>
